summary.text: Red Lotus true inheritance is Red Lotus Demon Venerable's legacy. Heavenly Court treats a red lotus mark as proof of an inheritor and calls for the true inheritance's destruction.

claims.text: On a Fate Immortal Gu vision of a Southern Border nameless peak, Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord sees a bright red lotus mark on a mysterious rank seven Gu Immortal’s forehead and names him an inheritor of Red Lotus’ true inheritance, then resolves that the true inheritance must be destroyed with no traces left.
Spectral Soul Demon Venerable considers whether help from this Red Lotus true inheritance can make him half an otherworldly demon.
Later, his will watches events from inside that Red Lotus true inheritance and draws Ying Wu Xie’s will into the red lotus space in the River of Time.

Red Lotus Demon Venerable arranges all seven of his true inheritances on stone lotus islands at different areas of the River of Time. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable obtains one such island, remakes it into Shadow Sect’s greatest information channel, and praises the power of Red Lotus’ time path true inheritance for watching past and present through the river. Spring Autumn Cicada is the crucial key to Red Lotus’ true inheritances.

Fang Yuan inherits one of the seven: the island’s true meaning has already been absorbed by Spectral Soul, but the true inheritance contents are handed down, most importantly the full set of Spring Autumn Cicada Immortal Gu recipes from rank six through rank nine. Among the venerable true inheritances he holds at that point, Red Lotus’ true inheritance ranks second after Spectral Soul’s.

Fang Yuan judges that Red Lotus Demon Venerable damaged fate Gu and left true inheritances, and that with Spring Autumn Cicada as the key he has a huge possibility of obtaining them; he has already used one Red Lotus true inheritance to kill Heavenly Court rank eight time path Gu Immortal Lord Huang Shi, and he hopes other Red Lotus true inheritances may hold a path to destroy fate Immortal Gu. He still delays hunting them until his battle strength can face Heavenly Court’s next River of Time response.

Red Lotus Demon Venerable builds the first and most important stone lotus island around rank eight regret Gu for an otherworldly demon with the greatest hope of destroying Fate, and leaves true meaning, time path immortal materials, immortal killer moves, and further arrangements there. Red Lotus’ true meaning welcomes Fang Yuan and tells him to accept the true inheritance; Fang Yuan refines regret Gu on the spot.

Over the following days he absorbs Red Lotus’ true meaning and reaches time path quasi-supreme grandmaster, while the inheritance also supplies high rank time path materials and immortal killer moves built around Spring Autumn Cicada, including spring autumn success, which raises Spring Autumn Cicada’s activation success rate to one hundred percent while still reducing luck, and the weakened killer move future self. The complete contents are plentiful, but Red Lotus does not leave a shortcut method to destroy fate Gu.

Heavenly Court finds and traps a stone lotus island with river suppression lotus sealing formation while hunting Red Lotus’ true inheritances, and Feng Jiu Ge destroys the island with winds of assimilation rather than let Fang Yuan take it. Fang Yuan and Longevity Heaven obstruct that effort; afterward Fang Yuan and Bing Sai Chuan confirm the true inheritance is gone, so neither side obtains it, a result that is neither defeat nor victory. Bing Sai Chuan does not know that Fang Yuan has already obtained one true inheritance in secret.

On a stone lotus island, Red Lotus’ will gives Feng Jiu Ge a true inheritance suited to him: rank eight future self, which can grant pseudo venerable battle strength, and an incomplete Immortal Gu recipe of destiny Gu tied to destiny song. Feng Jiu Ge accepts the true inheritance while refusing to destroy Fate or resist Heavenly Court solely because of it.
Before taking wisdom Gu from Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable has already obtained one Red Lotus true inheritance and made a deal with Red Lotus Demon Venerable.

Demon Immortal Qi Jue judges that Spectral Soul’s greatest venerable true inheritance gain was still that Red Lotus true inheritance, left to him intentionally by Red Lotus Demon Venerable to allow them to cooperate.

Holders.text: Spectral Soul Demon Venerable Fang Yuan Feng Jiu Ge

Location.text: River of Time; stone lotus islands
